text: ‘Globalisation has led to an increase in social inequality.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘International aid programmes have been ineffective in reducing poverty.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Media representations of women reflect patriarchal values.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Government is the main influence on media content.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘The role of religion is to maintain social control.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Religion is still an important influence in people’s lives.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
